d: Ian gets a call from a top Hollywood picture car coordinator and works his magic to get a vintage race car back in action.

st: An Elephant in an Ice Rink
d: Ian is commissioned to help build a wild, massive mobile floating party island for a prestigious festival in the Nevada desert (Burning Man).

A new client comes into the picture with a vintage desire; a hand-built motorcycle in the vein of early Harley Davidson’s, but with a Full Custom twist.  And later, Ian pushes the envelope with a cool electric bike build for himself.
An old client brings in Ian to build a classic 54’ Chevy pickup truck from the ground up with some major custom upgrades.

One of Ian’s most infamous show cars, Space Junkie, comes back to into the shop in a bizarre turn of events.  The gem is in desperate need of rehab and Ian brings it back to life, better than ever, with some major reworking!
